svg.title: Prem Sai Kota, Full-Stack Engineer
svg.desc: Prem Sai Kota, Full-Stack Engineer. I build real-time, collaborative products and the tooling behind them. Based in Hyderabad, IN, open to roles. Now building: NEXUS (Voice-first desktop companion; Rust · Tauri), Mahayuddh (DSA practice arena; Next.js · Supabase). Latest push: Engine-NEXUS/NEXUS-PAPERS, Nov 6.
